description: Fetch one Agent Connectors listing by slug. Returns the same object as /api/tools/{slug}.json: name, description, category, collection, status, publisher class (vendor, reference, community, or unknown), connect snippets per client, sourced facts with their sources, link-check results and dates, and the source URLs. A field the catalogue does not have is omitted. This does not run or test that server.
